name: doleleilao
description: Dole Leilão — SaaS de leilões online. Planejamento em specs/.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @doleleilao/design-tokens && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @doleleilao/design-tokens && npm run test:api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && ../../bin/php vendor/bin/pint --test && ../../bin/php vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress && ../../bin/php vendor/bin/deptrac analyse --no-progress
